title: Self Assessment Manual
summary: This manual contains guidance and processes for Self Assessment (SA)

title: Accredited official statistics: Government revenues from UK oil and gas production: October 2026
summary: Government revenues from oil and gas production, including payments and repayments of offshore Corporation Tax, Supplementary Charge, Energy Profits Levy and Petroleum Revenue Tax.

title: Accredited official statistics: HMRC tax receipts and National Insurance contributions for the UK
summary: This publication includes historical receipts on a monthly and annual basis for all taxes administered by HMRC, as well as expenditure relating to tax credits, Child Benefit and Tax-Free Childcare. The bulletin also includes analysis and commentary on year-to-date receipts.

title: Guidance: Appendix 1: DE 1/10: Requested and Previous Procedure Codes of the Customs Declaration Service (CDS)
summary: Find out the completion rules and instructions for each 4-digit Requested and Previous Procedure Code that can be used in Data Element (DE) 1/10 for Imports.

title: Accredited official statistics: HMRC tax receipts and National Insurance contributions for the UK
summary: Summary of HM Revenue and Customs' tax receipts, National Insurance contributions (NICs), and expenditure for the UK.

title: Official Statistics: HMRC statistics: pre-release access list
summary: HM Revenue and Customs' record of those who have pre-release access to Official Statistics.

title: Official Statistics: Council Tax: stock of properties, 2026
summary: Statistics on the stock of domestic properties by Council Tax Band in England and Wales.

title: Compliance Handbook
summary: The aim of the Compliance Handbook is to help users understand and apply HMRC's penalties and compliance powers, as set out by legislation.

title: Guidance: Report Pillar 2 top-up taxes: service availability and issues
summary: Check the availability and any issues affecting the Report Pillar 2 top-up taxes service.

title: Corporate report: Administrative Burdens Advisory Board 'Tell ABAB' report 2025 to 2026
summary: A report summarising the responses to an annual online survey that aims to improve HMRC's service to small businesses.

title: Guidance: Payrolling benefits and expenses online service: service availability and issues
summary: Check the availability and any issues affecting the payrolling benefits and expenses online service.

title: Statistics at HMRC
summary: HMRC statistics on taxes and benefits administered by HMRC.

title: Corporate report: HMRC statistics review 2026
summary: This review examines the causes of errors in HMRC’s Official Statistics affecting market-sensitive statistics and makes recommendations for improvements.

title: Check if a letter you’ve received from HMRC is genuine
summary: Check a list of recent letters from HMRC to help you decide if a letter you’ve received is a scam.

title: Check the recognised overseas pension schemes notification list
summary: Find schemes that have told HMRC they meet the conditions to be a recognised overseas pension scheme (ROPS).

title: Check if a business is registered for money laundering supervision
summary: Find out if a business has registered with HMRC under the money laundering regulations and report them if they have not.

title: Withdraw funds from your Customs Declaration Service cash account
summary: Make a request to withdraw funds from your cash account.

title: Guidance: Income Record Viewer for agents: service availability and issues
summary: Check the availability and any issues affecting the Income Record Viewer for agents service.

title: Official Statistics: Creative industries statistics: September 2026
summary: Information on the creative industries’ tax reliefs for film, high-end television, animation, children’s television, video games, theatre, orchestra, and museums and galleries exhibitions, including statistics on AVEC and VGEC.

title: Capital Gains Manual
summary:
HMRC is reviewing the CG Manual to ensure it provides
HMRC’s interpretation of relevant legislation where there is more than one
reasonable view of how rules work.Where material in the CG Manual isn’t
providing an interpretation, that material is being removed. Where appropriate,
material will be reproduced elsewhere and linked from the CG Manual.
